witness.branch: Continuation toward sidewalk during steady indication
witness.quote: must proceed to a curb, sidewalk, safety zone if one is provided or other place of safety as soon as possible.
witness.reason: Pedestrian travel can include an ongoing highway crossing toward the fixed sidewalk during the steady indication.
required_context: Establish connected trail, crossing and sidewalk geometry without placing the sidewalk on the trail by assumption.
Establish connections among trail, sidewalk and actual crossing route without assuming they occupy the same segment.
Establish highway boundaries and accessible sidewalk geometry and status.
Keep as soon as possible and other place of safety uninterpreted.
Preserve lawful-entry dependencies, access restrictions and opening exceptions.
Preserve movement, pauses, reversals, elapsed time and physical constraints without treating any one observation as dispositive.
Provide a governing illuminated steady indication and retain earlier signal and entry history.
Retain highway boundaries, sidewalk status and accessibility, prior indications, entry history and the steady transition.
Retain speed, pauses, reversals, elapsed time and physical circumstances without assigning legal significance.
The texts of subparagraphs (1) and (2) are supplied here; lawful entry and introductory-exception applicability still require relevant facts and remaining source provisions.
